description: issue #874's gating half: the SAME source as arity-paren-home-too-many, checked without `turtle-rendering` active. `home` is then not a visible name, so its arity is not statically known and the call belongs to ol-unknown-command alone — exactly ONE finding, never an arity one alongside it. This is `spec/tooling.md:175-176` ("MUST use the active conformance profile set when deciding which primitives … are available") and the two rules' never-double-report contract, which the fix makes structural by arity-checking only names the unknown-command rule already considers visible. ON THE DIRECTORY: this fixture deliberately declares only `core-language` while living under turtle-rendering/, which is the one place that combination is right — it is the absence half of a differential pair whose presence half (arity-paren-home-too-many) holds byte-identical source and differs ONLY in the declared profiles. Keeping the pair together is what makes the profile field demonstrably live rather than decorative; the harness selects on the declared profiles, not on the directory (scripts/harness/index.mjs).
